fusions.name: Gale Heave
fusions.desc: Heaves a gust that deals 14 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Tailwind Flap
fusions.desc: Beats a gust ahead of you, dealing 24 damage to everything in the cone. Allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Make Sail
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance while it holds.

fusions.name: Sea Legs
fusions.desc: When you cover a stretch of ground, you gain a ward that absorbs 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
